description: Locale configuration for Lithuanian language in Moment.js library, defining date/time formats, relative time, months, weekdays, and locale-specific functions.

methods.name: translateSeconds
methods.description: Translates seconds into Lithuanian relative time string.

methods.name: translateSingular
methods.description: Returns the correct form of a time unit based on plurality and context.

methods.name: special
methods.description: Checks if a number ends with 0 or is between 11 and 19 for pluralization rules.

methods.name: forms
methods.description: Splits the unit string into its different grammatical forms.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Generates the correct relative time string for a given number and context.
